thread:
Sam: Quick heads up — Prospect (HelixLabs) wants BYOK for the POC and a custom signing sequence: EU procurement signs order form, then US exec countersigns MSA. Their legal attached a redline.

Devon: Can you drop the exact BYOK clause they pasted? Legal will need it for a quick look.

Sam: They requested: "Customer-controlled KMS for encryption of data at rest; Redwood may not have access to plaintext keys, and keys must be managed by Customer." Also: list of infra subprocessors must be contractually enumerated.

Maria: We can support BYOK, but only in Dedicated/Private deployments — not our hosted public API. Also need to clarify "no access to plaintext keys" because some operational actions (e.g., emergency support, lawful process) need careful handling.

Jin: Finance note — HelixLabs asks for Net90 and PO up front for the POC invoices. Standard is Net30, we sometimes do Net60 for pilots. Net90 needs leadership signoff. How big is the pilot commit?

Claudia: Pilot is 3 months with expected ARR ~$220k if converted. Sales is willing to accept Net60 for POC; escalate Net90 to VP if they hold firm.

Devon: Technical workaround: we can spin a private-VPC POC with customer-managed KMS (HSM) and audit log streaming. That meets their BYOK requirement and keeps keys out of our control.

Sam: The DocuSign flow fails for the two-envelope request — current template assumes single-envelope multi-signer. Procurement insists EU-first signing because of internal compliance.

Maria: Operationally two-envelope is OK. Proposed precedence clause to bind DPA to the MSA and keep data obligations intact:

```Order of Precedence: To the extent of any inconsistency, the MSA shall govern, followed by the Order Form, with the DPA governing data processing obligations and surviving termination.``` 

Sam: They also want a fully enumerated subprocessor list in contract. We normally provide a current list and a notice period rather than enumerating every infra provider.

Maria: Drafting subprocessor disclosure language:

"Redwood will provide Customer with a list of current Subprocessors and will notify Customer of material changes. Customer shall have thirty (30) days from notice to object in writing; absent agreement the Subprocessor may be engaged."

Jin: Finance can accept an emailed/scanned PO for POC invoicing. Need PO # and billing contact before first invoice.

Claudia: @Maria please prepare a short BYOK addendum snippet and the subprocessor clause. Sales needs counter-redline to Helix legal by EOD PST.

Maria: Will DM the redline. Key constraints: (1) BYOK allowed only for Dedicated/Private; (2) Redwood cannot accept contractual language that prevents us from complying with lawful requests or from performing necessary operational maintenance; (3) propose escrow/incident key-handling procedure instead of unrestricted "no access" wording.

Devon: POC deployment snippet to share with their infra/security team:

```yaml
deployment: private-vpc
kms: customer-managed-hsm
network: private-subnets + nat
logging: s3+kinesis-forwarding, retention: 90d
access: support limited via JIT ticketing
```

Sam: Good. I'll bundle Maria's redline + Devon's yaml and send to Helix legal in 30m. If they stick to Net90, I'll escalate to Claudia.

Jin: Approving Net60 for the POC pilot from finance. Net90 requires VP/exec approval; escalate if they don't budge.

Claudia: I'll be on standby for escalation. @Sam send me the counter when you post it.

deploy-bot: system: scheduled infra deploy tonight 23:00 UTC 4:00 window, no expected impact to POC onboarding.

Sam: Thanks all — sending counter now. Will update thread when they reply. :thumbsup:
